name: Vobiz test 3 - Every call on the account

parameters.content:
## Test 3: every call on the account
It watches every number on the account, including numbers used by other setups such as a CRM integration, without changing them. It checks once a minute.
1. Pick your credential.
2. Click **Fetch Test Event**: you see your latest answered call.
3. **Publish**, make any call, and within about a minute a new run appears under **Executions**.
